text: Welcome to Tarafab X A I, where market insights meet intelligent automation.
Your dashboard brings your balances, recent activity, and available investment products together, so you can review your account in one place.

Browse the investment products, and open one to review its limits, duration, fees, and stated terms. Confirm only when you understand them. Projected terms and profits actually credited are always shown separately, and you can follow every investment from your dashboard.

The X A I Automation Engine monitors your selected markets, and evaluates the rules you configure every minute. Each check and alert is recorded, so you can follow market activity and stay informed. It monitors and alerts. It does not place trades.
Explore investment opportunities, follow market activity, and stay informed throughout your investment journey. Understand the risks, and discover Tarafab X A I.
